name: Quality Enhancer
description: 7 independent quality-improvement techniques beyond sharpening: Clarity (midtone local contrast), Deband (removes compression banding with dithering), Detail Recovery (edge-aware local tone mapping), CA Fix (chromatic aberration removal), Bilateral Denoise (noise reduction preserving edges), HDR Expansion (shadow/highlight detail recovery), and Texture Boost (micro-contrast without halos). Each module can be enabled independently.
